title: What the Elevator Undertakes to Return: Grade Guarantees Under Storage Agreements
content:
What the elevator owes back is fixed by the programme's grade guarantee, and the guarantee is what decides whether a discount arises at all. This page states the three guarantees carried across Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and what follows from each.

## The three guarantees

**House average grade.** The member is owed grain of the house's average grade, and no discount is due however their own lot turns out, because their bushels were commingled the day they arrived.

**Receipt grade.** The member is owed the grade written on the receipt, and grain returned below it is discounted for each full grade step below, part steps not counting.

**Delivered lot grade.** The member is owed their own lot as delivered, and any shortfall is discounted the same way at the programme's heavier rate.

## Rechecks and suspension

A member who disputes the grade may ask for a recheck, which is charged at the programme's recheck fee unless the recheck moves the grade in the member's favour, in which case the fee is waived and the discount recomputed.

Billing is suspended while a recheck is worked, for no longer than the programme's hold maximum, after which billing resumes whether or not the recheck is finished.

## Where a discount is settled

Grade discounts are settled against the member's storage account and never against bushels, because taking bushels for a grade shortfall would change what is on hand.

## Where each line bites

| Guarantee the programme carries | Grain comes back below the guaranteed grade | What follows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| house average grade | the member's own lot grades lower | no discount is due |
| receipt grade | one full step below the grade on the receipt | one step is discounted |
| receipt grade | part of a step below | part steps do not count |
| delivered lot grade | short of the lot as delivered | the shortfall is discounted at the programme's heavier rate |

| Outcome of a recheck | The recheck charge |
| --- | --- |
| the grade moves in the member's favour | waived, and the discount recomputed |
| the grade does not move in the member's favour | charged at the programme's recheck fee |

## Illustration, on a hypothetical dispute

A member on a programme guaranteeing the receipt grade believes the grain has come back a step and a half below the receipt. A full step and a half yields one full step, the half not counting, so one step is discounted against the storage account. While the recheck runs, billing on that agreement stands suspended, and it resumes once the programme's hold maximum in calendar days has run whether or not the recheck has finished.
